WITH RECURSIVE data_points AS (
  SELECT 1 as id, 
         CASE abs(random() % 3)
           WHEN 0 THEN 'Group A'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Group B'
           ELSE 'Group C'
         END as category,
         abs(random() % 100) + 20 as value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id + 1,
         CASE abs(random() % 3)
           WHEN 0 THEN 'Group A'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Group B'
           ELSE 'Group C'
         END,
         abs(random() % 100) + 20
  FROM data_points 
  WHERE id < 30
)
SELECT category, value FROM data_points
